Good but the new update made it a bit less good. Great for how I usually learn, but it now has some flaws I don’t like.
1. It’s now formatted like a mobile app (in the iPad version). What I mean by that is that it is more vertical whereas in the previous version it fit the screen.
2. The ads. It’s a free app, so I’m not going to complain about the ads existing, it’s just the placement. In the quizzes, video ads will just pop up at random times (they fill the whole screen), whereas in the previous version they only occurred between questions. Very annoying. The other thing is the bottom ad when taking the quizzes. If you scroll to the bottom to click “next,” it will block the button. Since the ad is free-floating (not to the complete bottom of the screen), you have to scroll enough to see the “next” button, but enough that it will be below the ad.
3. When you click an answer, it automatically confirms. In the previous version, you chose the answer and clicked the “next” button to confirm. It is pretty annoying and I don’t see why it’s like that when it is a WRITTEN test. Not spoken, WRITTEN.
So yeah, pretty nice but has flaws. Would recommend if you can deal with these!!
